reason: I do not know any of these partners, and I cannot see real reviews from people I know yet. I would not hand my car and SAR 1,300 or more to a stranger's quote, even with the money held in the app.
objection: Who actually does the work on my car, and what happens if the film is badly fitted? I cannot check the installer, and a warranty on a website does not tell me the shop will still be there.
would_change_my_mind: A recommendation from a friend or family member who has already used a partner through ArmorHub and was happy with the result.
